title: LineupConfig
description: Server settings: where to listen, where to write HLS output, and which channels to serve.

channels.description: The channels to serve, in playlist order.

output.description: Where channels write their HLS output.

version.description: Schema version URI, e.g. "https://ersatztv.org/lineup/version/0.0.1"; missing is 0.0.0.

xmltv.description: Where to find guide data for `/xmltv.xml`. Unset serves channels without programmes.

config.description: Path to the channel's `channel.json`. A relative path is relative to the lineup file.

group.description:
Channel group in the M3U playlist (`/channels.m3u`), sent as `group-title`. Not used in
the XMLTV guide.

logo.description: Logo URL, sent as `tvg-logo` in the playlist and `icon` in the guide.

name.description: Channel name shown in the M3U playlist and XMLTV guide.

number.description:
Channel number, e.g. `1` or `2.1`. Used in URLs (`/channel/{number}.m3u8`) and as the
name of the channel's output subfolder, so it must be unique.

overlays.description:
Paths to channel config overlays, merged over `config` in order. An overlay value replaces
the base value, and `null` removes the key. Each overlay must carry its own `version`.
A relative path is relative to the lineup file.

tvg_id.description:
Guide ID that links the playlist entry to its XMLTV channel and names its guide file.
Unset is `ersatztv.{number}`.

folder.description:
Folder for HLS output. Each channel writes to a subfolder named after its `number`.
A relative path is relative to the lineup file.

bind_address.description: IP address to listen on. `0.0.0.0` listens on all IPv4 interfaces.

folder.description:
Folder of per-channel guide files named `{tvg_id}.xml`. Their `programme` elements are
copied into `/xmltv.xml`; a missing file is skipped. A relative path is relative to the
lineup file.
